[EN] Sleep? I remember sleep. We don't get much of it. Have to stay frosty in case the orcans suddenly remember there's only a handful of us and rush this place.
[ES] ¿Dormir? Recuerdo el sueño. No dormimos mucho. Hay que estar alerta por si los orcans de repente recuerdan que solo somos un puñado y atacan este lugar.
